explanation: Kinematic point W=1.6 GeV, Q2=1.0 GeV^2, cos(theta*)=0 is physically valid for eta electroproduction (eta threshold W_thr = m_p+m_eta ~= 1.486 GeV; the EtaMAID table grid in mpintp.inc spans Q2 in [0,5] GeV^2 and W up to ~6 GeV). phi* was interpreted as a 25-point linspace from 0 to 345 deg inclusive (step = 345/24 = 14.375 deg), matching 'phi* from 0 to 345 in 25 steps'. Chunking: the README's 10-point-per-file limit is explicitly documented (examples/README.md) as a constraint of the batch-runner shell scripts, not of the Fortran list-directed reader itself, which parses up to npoimax=10000 points from a single input.dat regardless of line breaks (exclurad.F line 18, confirmed by the 50-point examples/input_multi_chunk.dat working as one file/one exe call). Since this request has only 25 points and no batch/array scripts are present in this checkout, one single-chunk input file is sufficient -- no splitting was needed. Used eta-configuration defaults matching the repo's documented CLAS12 setup: model=3 (EtaMAID/maid2000), rc_mode=0 (full O(alpha) RC), bmom=6.53 GeV, ivec=1 (recoil proton), vcut=0.166 GeV^2 (standard CLAS12 eta inelasticity cut).
